task1.title: Layout of a university's sports centre now and after redevelopment
task1.prompt: The plans below show the layout of a university's sports centre now, and how it will look after redevelopment.

chartDesc.title: UNIVERSITY SPORTS CENTRE

views.name: future plans
features: Dance studio (two studios on the far east side)

changes: Outdoor courts on the west removed and replaced by a Leisure pool
Outdoor courts on the east removed and replaced by a Sports hall and two Dance studios
Addition of a Changing room and Sports shop in the south-west corner
Addition of a Café and a Changing room in the south-east corner
Gym extended to the east to cover the space above the new Sports hall
chartDesc.overview: The university sports centre will undergo significant expansion into a fully enclosed indoor complex. Both outdoor court areas will be redeveloped into new indoor facilities, alongside the addition of a café, sports shop, dance studios, and extra changing rooms.
keyFeatures: Replacement of western outdoor courts with a large Leisure pool
Replacement of eastern outdoor courts with a Sports hall and two Dance studios
Addition of a Sports shop and Changing room to the south-west of the building
Addition of a Café and Changing room to the south-east of the building
Expansion/extension of the Gym across the northern section
Retention of the central 25m Pool, original Changing room, Seating, and Reception

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Advances in agriculture and world hunger
task2.prompt:
In spite of the advances made in agriculture, many people around the world still go hungry.

Why is this the case?

What can be done about this problem?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
